test_set_seed_reproducibility: test that set_seed produces reproducible random numbers across torch, numpy, and random modules
test_get_distributed_env: test that get_distributed_env reads LOCAL_RANK, RANK, and WORLD_SIZE from environment variables
test_get_model_and_loss_fn: test that get_model_and_loss_fn returns an nn.Module model and CrossEntropyLoss on the given device
test_instantiate_optimizer: test that instantiate_optimizer creates an SGD or Adam optimizer from an OmegaConf config
test_setup_distribution: test that setup_distribution initializes the process group and returns the correct cpu or cuda device
